standard_prerequisites.name: The henselization is a colimit of etale algebras, and the strict henselization is a colimit of finite etale algebras
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-henselization} and Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-strict-henselization}, cited at proof lines 10927-10929 and 10936-10937
standard_prerequisites.use: Give the presentations from which flatness is read off.

standard_prerequisites.name: Etale maps are flat, flatness is stable under colimits, and a flat local homomorphism is faithfully flat
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-etale}, Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-colimit-flat}, and Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-local-flat-ff}, cited at proof lines 10928-10934
standard_prerequisites.use: Produce faithful flatness of the two ring maps.

standard_prerequisites.name: A flat local ring map which is an isomorphism on residue fields makes the source a basis of the target as a module over each Artinian quotient
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-local-artinian-basis-when-flat}, cited at proof lines 10946-10948 and 10951-10954
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives both the equality of the quotients and the freeness statement.

standard_prerequisites.name: Base change of a flat ring map is flat
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-flat-base-change}, cited at proof lines 10945-10947
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the induced map on the quotients by powers of the maximal ideal flat.

core_obligations: Read the colimit presentations of the henselization and the strict henselization off the standard constructions (proof lines 10927-10938).
Deduce flatness of both maps and then faithful flatness from the flat local criterion (proof lines 10929-10938).
Quote the description of the maximal ideals from the construction of the henselizations (proof lines 10940-10941).
Show the quotients of the henselization agree with those of the ring, using the Artinian basis criterion and base change of flatness (proof lines 10942-10948).
Choose elements of the strict henselization mapping to a basis of the separable closure and apply the same criterion to obtain the freeness statement (proof lines 10949-10954).
proof_roadmap: Faithful flatness from the colimit presentations (proof lines 10927-10938).
The maximal ideals from the constructions (proof lines 10940-10941).
Quotients by powers of the maximal ideal via the Artinian basis criterion (proof lines 10942-10954).
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects four basic properties of the henselization and strict henselization of a local ring: faithful flatness of both maps, the behaviour of the maximal ideal, agreement of the quotients by powers of the maximal ideal, and freeness of the quotients of the strict henselization over the corresponding quotients of the ring. The proof reads faithful flatness off the colimit presentations by etale and finite etale algebras and the fact that a flat local homomorphism is faithfully flat, quotes the behaviour of the maximal ideal, and obtains the two statements about residue rings from the criterion on bases of local Artinian algebras when a flat local map identifies the residue fields, applied to the base changed flat maps and, in the last case, to a basis of the separable closure chosen in the strict henselization.
